I love the taste

I came in for the creamers, the Blend packs and cuz getting my pumpkin spice on sounded funny and it all came out to be like just a bit more expensive then starting the subscription was. I had no real like need for the wooden container or scoop or spoon and actually gifted the tumbler and a creamer pack and the rest of the pumpkin spice to my friend that first had me try a two week supply of ryze from their supply.

but i kind of started enjoying what it feels like to open it in the morning for my coffee. I tend to mix my serving into regular coffee and recommend this if you struggle with how its instant coffee blended and drink fancy coffee like I do, its still pretty good by itself and blends well into things like protein shakes too.
Overall. After my friend hooked me up with some, I reallt started a little over a month ago with a bag I picked up from a local Target and I can really feel and see the way it bolsters where it does,
So this next part is important but in no way is it said provide medical advice or behavioral health advice.

I have DPDR+AD+ADHD and really struggle with turning the gears into motion after a certain wall is hit or just wake up with it. I take 54mg ER Methylphenidate every morning at 6:00 AM among other medications. Because these contain mushrooms that relate to how your brain functions i want to specify my experience to showcase its important to be mindful and think Ryzes staffing would like that I do this because its part of their overall values, to support a better version of you.

Because of this, through trial and error I have learned i Need to finish my daily Ryze either 60 minutes before I take anything like mood stabilizers or Ritalin or metabolism altering medications or wait 60 minutes to start drinking Ryze for proper absorption of my medications and processing of Ryzes blend to avoid an overlap that causes me to become overstimulated, this happens because of how my medications work, not because of how Ryze works, Ryze is working as they intended since I follow its recommended serving size.

I got a gastric sleeve surgery at the end of 2022 which impacts how I absorb nutrients and how things like medications and substances interact with my body and organs, I am sharing this piece of my history to showcase why I am informed about what I am saying for how it all works out as your body processes things you consume and you experience how they do.
Ryze is fantastic so far, I feel organized, centered, motivated and can see where it oils the right gears in the brain and body because of how the disorder DP/DR works.

Obviously lifestyle changes are what shapes how it works by default. If you stay on the fence. Then pick up at least a month's supply from a grocery store before you really climb into it. Ive been surprised.

Also, plug for how unmanipulative their marketing is and plug for how it never claims to be able to resolve Behavioral Health and Physical Health variables that professionals should be coordinated with and consulted with over, this integrity it important to me. I dont want wonder solutions. I appreciate the level of transparency you can easily find about what they offer with this ecosystem.
Thanks.
